top_signals.title: Canada’s Oilfield Services Sector Is Gearing Up for a Stronger 2027
top_signals.summary: Canada’s oilfield services market is ending 2026 stronger than it began. Well spuds fell 3%, and the number of fracked wells fell 5% in the first half, but a sharp second-half pickup, driven by higher commodity prices after the US-Iran war, leaves drilling and completion activity flat for the year measured by total wells spud and wells fracked.
